title: Closing Rate on a Hotel Folio Carrying a Property Notice
content:
The closing rate from which the closing night charge on a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range is worked out is read from the property notices standing on the folio and from how many room nights have already been posted there.

Where the folio carries a property notice about the reservation and the room nights already posted number 5 or more, the closing rate is the average of the room nights already posted, rounded to the cent.

Where the folio carries a property notice about the reservation and the room nights already posted number fewer than 5, the closing rate is the highest room night already posted.

In every other case the closing rate is the rate of the latest room night already posted to the folio.

| Property notice on the folio | Room nights already posted | The closing rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Yes | 5 or more | The average of the room nights already posted, rounded to the cent |
| Yes | Fewer than 5 | The highest room night already posted |
| No | Any number | The rate of the latest room night already posted |

*The combinations, on a hypothetical folio.* Room nights of 200.00, 260.00, 210.00, 245.00 and 230.00 USD stand on the folio, posted in that order. With a property notice on the folio, the five posted nights meet the count of 5, so the closing rate is their total of 1145.00 USD divided by 5, or 229.00 USD. Were only four of those nights posted — 200.00, 260.00, 210.00 and 245.00 USD — the count would fall below 5 and the closing rate would be the highest of them, 260.00 USD. With no property notice on the folio, either set gives the latest night posted: 230.00 USD in the first case and 245.00 USD in the second.
